title: Junior German Speaking IT Support Specialist

summary.lv: Atea Global Services meklē Junior IT atbalsta speciālistu ar vācu valodas prasmēm Servicedesk komandai — apstrādāt incidentus, atrisināt tehniskās problēmas attālināti un nodrošināt komunikāciju ar klientiem.
summary.en: Atea Global Services is hiring a junior German-speaking IT support specialist for the Servicedesk team to handle incidents, resolve technical issues remotely, and communicate with customers in German.
